description: This file contains functions for parsing Lua source code documentation comments, extracting parameters, descriptions, examples, and generating method declarations. It also includes functions to parse header files and generate module documentation.

methods.name: from_md
methods.description: Converts markdown text with inline code delimiters into HTML with <code> tags.

methods.name: parse_param
methods.description: Parses a parameter string into a table with name and description.

methods.name: parse_description
methods.description: Extracts the main description text from a comment block, ignoring tags.

methods.name: parse_bottom_description
methods.description: Extracts the bottom part of a description from a comment block, handling examples and ignoring tags.

methods.name: parse_return
methods.description: Parses the @return tag from a comment to extract variable name and description.

methods.name: parse_examples
methods.description: Extracts example code blocks from comments, including live examples and call indices.

methods.name: parse_calls
methods.description: Parses @call and @param tags from comments to build call argument structures.

methods.name: parse_comment
methods.description: Parses a documentation comment block into a structured method or event description.

methods.name: get_declaration
methods.description: Generates a function call string from a method name and parameters.

methods.name: get_declarations
methods.description: Generates multiple declaration strings for all calls of a method.

methods.name: parse_params
methods.description: Extracts all @param tags from a comment into a list of parameter tables.

methods.name: parse_header
methods.description: Parses header file content to extract documented methods and callback functions.

methods.name: remove_html_tags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Finds header files in a directory, parses them, and returns module documentation structures.
